claim: *One Measurement, Different Enforcement Decisions.* The same measured quantity may be observed without enforcement, used to adapt behavior, trigger graceful degradation, or control admission. The appropriate response follows from the obligation attached to the measurement.
topology: One model through one policy fans out to alternative responses; adaptation has a degradation child.
required_terms: Response follows the obligation attached to the quantity.
bw_encoding: Observe remains white, adaptation light gray, admission gate dark gray: three policy modes restored. All strokes and fills are neutral grayscale; labels remain the primary semantic key. Existing dashed meanings are preserved.
redesign: Native nodes and routed edges preserve the original semantic structure, with print-sized labels and fewer decorative frames. Grayscale refinement: Observe remains white, adaptation light gray, admission gate dark gray: three policy modes restored.
alt:
A single cost and usage model is read through a policy attached to the value. That policy
    selects one response. Observe reports evidence without consequence. Adapt changes load, throttling and
    then producing soft completion rather than outright rejection. Gate blocks admission and is dormant
    unless configured. The appropriate response follows from the obligation attached to the measurement, not
    from a maturity sequence.
